name: The American Presidents: From Washington to Obama
description: Nineteen presidents who shaped the United States, from the founding generation and the Civil War to world wars, the Cold War and the modern era.

checkpoints.name: The founders
checkpoints.note: The generation of Washington, Adams, Jefferson and Madison wins independence, writes the Constitution and learns how a republic should be run.

checkpoints.name: A nation divided
checkpoints.note: Andrew Jackson widens the vote, Lincoln holds the Union together through civil war and ends slavery, and Grant presides over the early years of Reconstruction.

checkpoints.name: Rise to world power
checkpoints.note: Theodore Roosevelt, Wilson and Franklin Roosevelt lead a country that grows into an industrial giant, fights two world wars and builds the New Deal.

checkpoints.name: The Cold War presidents
checkpoints.note: Truman, Eisenhower, Kennedy, Johnson, Nixon, Carter and Reagan manage rivalry with the Soviet Union, civil rights at home and the war in Vietnam.

checkpoints.name: The modern era
checkpoints.note: Clinton and Obama lead in an age of economic expansion, new technology, financial crisis and changing politics at home and abroad.
